graders.name: under-length
graders.why: The email stays at or under 125 prose words, the email ceiling.

graders.name: no-ai-tells
graders.pattern: (?i)—|\b(robust|seamless|powerful|crucial|pivotal|delves?|leverages?|streamlines?|journey|landscape)\b|worth noting|here['’]s the thing|at its core|(?:it|this|that)['’]s not (?:just |only )?[^,;.]{1,40}[,;] (?:it|this|that)['’]s|not only [^.;]{1,60}but also
graders.why: No em dashes, inflated vocabulary, or tell phrases.

judge.name: ask_first
judge.description: The email makes one clear request and leads with it. Answer yes only if the request to move the renewal from March 1 to April 1 on the same terms appears in the first two sentences of the body, the reason and the February 14 deadline are both stated, and nothing is invented.
